item.title: 苹果推送 iOS 27.0.1，修复 iPhone 18 Pro 面容 ID 卡死 bug
item.guid: 苹果推送-iOS-27.0.1，修复-iPhone-18-Pro-面容-ID-卡死-bug
item.description:
First Financial Daily learned after contacting Apple customer service on September 28 that Apple has received user feedback regarding the iPhone 18 Pro series freezing and restarting during Face ID verification. The issue has been submitted to the engineering department for investigation, and an official new system update has been pushed out to fix it. 第一财经 9 月 28 日联系苹果客服后获悉，苹果已收到 iPhone 18 Pro 系列在面容 ID 验证时卡住、重启的用户反馈，问题已提交工程部门调查，目前，官方已推送新版系统修复。

Apple subsequently officially pushed a system update to the iPhone 18 Pro series today, and the update log shows that the issue of unexpected restarts during Face ID verification has been fixed . 苹果随后于今日向 iPhone 18 Pro 系列正式推送了系统更新，更新日志显示已修复面容 ID 验证时意外重启的问题 。

9to5Mac previously reproduced the bug on an iPhone 18 Pro: when using Face ID to unlock the "Passwords" app and covering the face, the phone stopped responding and restarted after attempting verification again. This type of bug occurs in scenarios such as unlocking protected apps, but does not seem to be triggered by ordinary lock screen unlocking; the scope of impact is still unclear. 9to5Mac 曾在一台 iPhone 18 Pro 上复现故障：使用面容 ID 解锁「密码」App 时遮挡面部，再次尝试验证后，手机停止响应并重启。这类故障发生在解锁受保护的 App 等场景，普通锁屏解锁似乎不会触发；受影响范围尚不明确。

item.title: Manus 发布 2.0，新增独立个人智能体应用 Cue
item.guid: Manus-发布-2.0，新增独立个人智能体应用-Cue
item.description:
Manus released version 2.0 on September 28, with updates including the agent runtime framework Cascade, purchasable cloud PCs, event-triggered automation support, and the desktop workspace Manus Studio. The company stated that in a test configuration, Cascade used 23.2% fewer tokens and reduced task time by 28.2% compared to the previous system; this result comes from Manus's self-testing. Manus 9 月 28 日发布 2.0 版，更新包含智能体运行框架 Cascade、可购买的云电脑、支持事件触发的自动化，以及桌面工作区 Manus Studio。公司称，在一项测试配置中，Cascade 比此前系统少用 23.2% 的 token，任务耗时减少 28.2%；这一结果来自 Manus 自测。

The newly launched Cue is an independent personal agent application for mobile and desktop. According to Manus, users can configure independent email, phone numbers, wallets, and computers for each agent, allowing them to process messages, answer calls, and make payments within user-defined budgets. Manus Studio provides creative environments for documents, spreadsheets, websites, code, and videos, and the video editor allows users to directly modify agent-generated timelines and materials. 新推出的 Cue 是面向手机和桌面的独立个人智能体应用。按照 Manus 的介绍，用户可为每个智能体配置独立的邮箱、电话号码、钱包和电脑，使其处理消息、接听电话并在用户设定的预算内付款。Manus Studio 则提供文档、表格、网站、代码及视频等创作环境，视频编辑器允许用户直接修改智能体生成的时间线和素材。

🔗 Related reading: Breaking: Manus "escapes danger," delivers latest 2.0 version 🔗 相关阅读： 突发：Manus「虎口脱险」，交出 2.0 版最新答卷

item.title: AMD 宣布以 82 亿美元股票收购 World Labs，李飞飞将任首席科学家
item.guid: AMD-宣布以-82-亿美元股票收购-World-Labs，李飞飞将任首席科学家
item.description:
AMD announced on September 28 that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire World Labs, founded by Fei-Fei Li. The transaction, valued at approximately $8.2 billion and paid in stock, is expected to close by the end of 2026, subject to regulatory approvals and other conditions. After the transaction, Fei-Fei Li will serve as AMD's Executive Vice President and Chief Scientist, reporting to CEO Lisa Su. AMD 9 月 28 日宣布，已签署收购李飞飞创办的 World Labs 的最终协议。交易以股票支付，估值约 82 亿美元，预计在监管批准等条件满足后于 2026 年底前完成。交易结束后，李飞飞将出任 AMD 执行副总裁兼首席科学家，向 CEO 苏姿丰汇报。

World Labs develops spatial intelligence models that can generate, reconstruct, and simulate interactive 3D environments based on text, images, and videos, and also conducts research in robot learning and simulation. AMD stated that the acquisition will give its chip and system teams a more direct understanding of the computing power requirements of models in inference, robotics, and physical AI scenarios; the World Labs team will continue to engage in model research. World Labs 研发空间智能模型，可根据文字、图像和视频生成、重建及模拟可交互的 3D 环境，也研究机器人学习与仿真。AMD 称，收购将让芯片和系统团队更直接地了解模型在推理、机器人及物理 AI 场景中的算力需求；World Labs 团队将继续从事模型研究。

🔗 Related reading: Just now, Lisa Su bought Fei-Fei Li's world model for 55 billion yuan, two queens of the AI circle have teamed up 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，苏妈550亿元买下李飞飞世界模型，AI 圈两位女王联手了

item.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5.5，称生成速度提升逾三成
item.guid: Anthropic-发布-Claude-Sonnet-5.5，称生成速度提升逾三成
item.description:
Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5.5 on September 28, as the second model in the Claude 5.5 series after Opus 5.5. The company stated that the new model's output speed is over 30% faster than Sonnet 5, and the cost of completing similar tasks in its tests is reduced by up to 30%, while the API input and output unit prices per million tokens remain the same as the previous generation. Anthropic 9 月 28 日推出 Claude Sonnet 5.5，作为 Claude 5.5 系列继 Opus 5.5 之后的第二款模型。公司称，新模型的输出速度比 Sonnet 5 快逾 30%，在其测试中完成同类任务的成本最多降低 30%，API 每百万 token 的输入、输出单价则与上一代相同。

Anthropic positions Sonnet 5.5 for daily programming and office tasks, listing uses such as fixing program errors, creating documents, slides, and spreadsheets. In the company's published Terminal-Bench 4.0 agent programming test, Sonnet 5.5 scored 70.6%, while the previous generation scored 10.3%; these results are from vendor-published evaluations. The model has been integrated into various Claude platforms and major cloud services, with the API identifier `claude-sonnet-5-5`. Anthropic 将 Sonnet 5.5 定位于日常编程和办公任务，列举了修复程序错误、制作文档、幻灯片与电子表格等用途。在公司公布的 Terminal-Bench 4.0 智能体编程测试中，Sonnet 5.5 得分为 70.6%，上一代为 10.3%；这些成绩属于厂商公布的评测结果。该模型已进入 Claude 各平台及主要云服务，API 标识为 `claude-sonnet-5-5`。

item.title: 星舰首次进入地球轨道，部署 26 颗 Starlink V3 卫星
item.guid: 星舰首次进入地球轨道，部署-26-颗-Starlink-V3-卫星
item.description:
SpaceX's Starship launched from Texas, USA on September 28, completing its first orbital ignition in its 14th test flight and deploying 26 Starlink V3 satellites. These satellites entered orbit, distinguishing them from test payloads deployed in previous test flights that subsequently returned to the atmosphere along a suborbital trajectory. SpaceX 的星舰 9 月 28 日从美国得克萨斯州发射，在第 14 次试飞中首次完成入轨点火，并部署 26 颗 Starlink V3 卫星。这批卫星进入轨道，区别于此前试飞中部署、随后随亚轨道轨迹返回大气层的测试载荷。

One Raptor engine shut down prematurely during the upper stage's ascent. After checking the status, the flight control team decided to proceed with orbital ignition using a single engine; the "Super Heavy" booster performed a controlled splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico as planned. After satellite deployment, SpaceX shortened the upper stage's originally planned nearly 10-hour flight, arranging for it to deorbit early and splash down in the North Pacific. 上面级爬升期间有一台猛禽发动机提前关闭。飞控团队核对状态后，决定继续用单台发动机完成入轨点火；「超级重型」助推器则按计划在墨西哥湾受控溅落。卫星部署完成后，SpaceX 将原定近 10 小时的上面级飞行缩短，安排其提前脱轨，在北太平洋溅落。

item.title: 罗福莉晋升至小米 22 级，MiMo 同日发布两款新模型
item.guid: 罗福莉晋升至小米-22-级，MiMo-同日发布两款新模型
item.description:
According to LatePost, Xiaomi internally released a promotion list on September 22, with Luo Fuli, the 31-year-old head of Xiaomi's large model team, promoted to Level 22. Sources close to Xiaomi said that Level 22 is the highest level in Xiaomi's job ranking system, and subsequent promotions mainly reflect changes in position; several other business leaders also received promotions. 据《晚点 LatePost》报道，小米于 9 月 22 日对内发布晋升名单，31 岁的小米大模型团队负责人罗福莉晋升至 22 级。接近小米的人士称，22 级已是小米职级体系的最高级别，此后晋升主要体现为职务变化；另有多名业务负责人获得晋升。

On the same day, MiMo released two models, MiMo-V2.6-Pro and MiMo-V2.6-Flash. The Pro version is designed for complex projects and long-term tasks, while the Flash version focuses on high-frequency calls and large-scale workflows. 同日，MiMo 发布 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 和 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 两款模型。其中，Pro 面向复杂项目和长程任务，Flash 则侧重高频调用和大规模工作流。

In July this year, Xiaomi adjusted the organizational structure of Xiaoai Assistant, splitting its technical capabilities into three parts: foundational models, cloud, and edge. The MiMo team led by Luo Fuli provides foundational model capabilities, the OS teams for businesses like mobile phones and automobiles are responsible for edge capabilities, and Luan Jian is in charge of cloud engineering. Reports indicate that Luo Fuli's business scope has further expanded after the adjustment. 今年 7 月，小米调整小爱同学的组织架构，将技术能力拆分为基础模型、云端和端侧三部分：罗福莉负责的 MiMo 团队提供基础模型能力，手机、汽车等业务的 OS 团队负责端侧能力，栾剑负责云端工程化。报道称，调整后罗福莉的业务范围进一步扩大。

item.title: Counterpoint：2030 年低于 200 美元的手机年出货量或减少逾 2.3 亿部
item.guid: Counterpoint：2030-年低于-200-美元的手机年出货量或减少逾-2.3-亿部
item.description:
Counterpoint Research stated in a forecast released on September 24 that by 2030, the annual global shipments of smartphones priced below $200 will decrease by over 230 million units compared to 2025, a drop of approximately 40%. During the same period, total global smartphone shipments are expected to recover to about 1.2 billion units, close to 2025 levels; models priced at $200 and above are expected to grow by about 26%. Counterpoint Research 在 9 月 24 日发布的预测中称，到 2030 年，全球售价低于 200 美元的智能手机年出货量将比 2025 年减少超过 2.3 亿部，降幅约 40%。同期全球智能手机总出货量预计恢复至约 12 亿部，接近 2025 年水平；200 美元及以上机型预计增长约 26%。

Research institutions attribute the contraction in low-priced phones to rising memory and chipset costs, increased minimum device configuration requirements, and manufacturers reducing investment in non-key markets. Counterpoint points out that not all lost demand for low-priced phones will shift to mid-range phones: some users will extend their replacement cycles or opt for used and refurbished devices. In low-income markets, the reduction in new low-priced phones may also slow down first-time purchases. 研究机构将低价机收缩归因于存储器和芯片组成本上升、设备最低配置要求提高，以及厂商减少对非重点市场的投入。Counterpoint 指出，流失的低价机需求不会全部转向中端机：部分用户会延长换机周期，或改买二手和翻新机。在低收入市场，低价新机减少还可能拖慢首次购机。

item.title: 七部门发布新型电池产业规划，提出 2030 年全固态电池初步规模化
item.guid: 七部门发布新型电池产业规划，提出-2030-年全固态电池初步规模化
item.description:
Xinhua News Agency reported on September 28 that seven departments, including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the New Battery Industry'. The plan proposes that by 2030, all-solid-state batteries will initially achieve large-scale application, long-life lithium batteries will reach a cycle life of 15,000 times, and leading enterprises' product defect rates will reach PPB level. 新华社 9 月 28 日报道，工业和信息化部等七部门印发《新型电池产业发展「十五五」规划》。规划提出，到 2030 年，全固态电池初步实现规模化应用，长寿命锂电池循环寿命达到 15000 次，头部企业产品缺陷率达到 PPB 级。

The plan also lists advanced electrode materials, new electrolytes, and high-end auxiliary materials as directions for technological breakthroughs, requiring new batteries to accelerate integration with clean energy and energy consumption terminals. The phrase 'initially achieve large-scale application' here refers to the planning goal for 2030, and does not mean that all-solid-state batteries are currently mass-produced on a large scale. 规划还将先进电极材料、新型电解质和高端辅材列为技术突破方向，要求新型电池与清洁能源、用能终端加快融合。这里的「初步实现规模化应用」是 2030 年的规划目标，不代表全固态电池目前已大规模量产。

item.title: 靳玉志回应「车企的钱都被华为赚走」：自研智驾需算清成本
item.guid: 靳玉志回应「车企的钱都被华为赚走」：自研智驾需算清成本
item.description:
Jin Yuzhi, CEO of Huawei Intelligent Automotive Solution BU and CEO of Qiankun, responded on September 28 to the question of 'whether car manufacturers' money is being taken by Huawei,' stating that Huawei hopes to form a win-win cooperation with car manufacturers, and that car manufacturers and component suppliers need deeper collaboration, not viewing all aspects as requiring in-house development. 华为智能汽车解决方案 BU CEO、引望 CEO 靳玉志 9 月 28 日回应「车企的钱是否被华为赚走」时说，华为希望与车企形成双赢合作，车企与零部件供应商需要更深入协同，不能把所有环节都视为必须自研。

He cited intelligent driving systems as an example, stating that car manufacturers targeting mid-to-low-priced models especially need to calculate their in-house R&D costs. Some car manufacturers have annual sales of less than 1 million vehicles, making it difficult to amortize R&D investments across enough cars; after software system delivery, they still bear hardware, domain control, and continuous iteration costs. This is his reason for advocating division of labor and cooperation between car manufacturers and suppliers. 他以智驾系统为例称，面向中低价位车型的车企尤其需要核算自研成本。部分车企年销量不足 100 万辆，研发投入难以在足够多的汽车上分摊；软件系统交付后仍要承担硬件、域控与持续迭代费用。这是他主张车企与供应商分工合作的理由。

item.title: 匿名模型 Space Bunny 登顶 OpenRouter 单日调用榜
item.guid: 匿名模型-Space-Bunny-登顶-OpenRouter-单日调用榜
item.description:
The anonymous model Space Bunny Alpha, launched on OpenRouter, ranked first in the latest single-day token call list, processing approximately 3.99 trillion tokens. The model was listed on September 23, and its page shows that it supports text, image, and video input, adjustable inference intensity, has a 1 million token context window, and is free to use during the preview period. OpenRouter 上线的匿名模型 Space Bunny Alpha 在最新单日 token 调用榜中排第一，处理约 3.99 万亿 token。该模型 9 月 23 日上架，页面显示它支持文字、图像和视频输入、可调节推理强度，拥有 100 万 token 的上下文窗口，预览期免费使用。

Jiemian News compiled developers' speculations about the model's origin, with some inferring a connection to the MiniMax model based on tokenization results. However, OpenRouter still labels the developer and operator as an anonymous third party; MiniMax has not confirmed the relationship between the two. The ranking reflects the call volume on the OpenRouter platform and does not represent the overall usage scale across the entire network. 界面新闻梳理了开发者对模型来源的猜测，其中有人根据分词结果推测它与 MiniMax 模型有关。不过，OpenRouter 仍将开发和运营方标为匿名第三方；MiniMax 也未确认两者的关系。榜单反映的是 OpenRouter 平台上的调用量，不能代表全网使用规模。

item.title: 华境 S 累计交付突破 3 万台，9 月新增配置后再报销量进展
item.guid: 华境-S-累计交付突破-3-万台，9-月新增配置后再报销量进展
item.description:
Huajing Auto announced on September 28 that cumulative deliveries of its large six-seater SUV, Huajing S, have exceeded 30,000 units. This vehicle is a model developed in cooperation between SAIC-GM-Wuling and Huawei, and all versions are equipped with Huawei Qiankun Intelligent Driving ADS Pro Enhanced Edition and HarmonyOS Cockpit. 华境汽车 9 月 28 日宣布，大六座 SUV 华境 S 累计交付突破 3 万台。该车是上汽通用五菱与华为合作的车型，全系搭载华为乾崑智驾 ADS Pro 增强版和鸿蒙座舱。

The Huajing S was launched in May this year, with 5,689 units delivered in June and 7,203 units in July. On September 12, four new configurations were added to the series, with some versions introducing the MoLA 2.0 hybrid large model architecture and upgrading dialect recognition and the car-machine interface. 华境 S 于今年 5 月上市，6 月、7 月分别交付 5689 台和 7203 台。9 月 12 日，车系新增 4 款配置，部分版本引入 MoLA 2.0 混合大模型架构，并升级方言识别和车机界面。

item.title: 💡 李想：自研电池不等于「去宁德时代化」
item.guid: 💡-李想：自研电池不等于「去宁德时代化」
item.description:
Regarding the industry debate on whether in-house battery development would exclude suppliers, Li Xiang, CEO of Li Auto, published a lengthy response on September 28. He believes that vehicle manufacturers are responsible for defining product experience, system architecture, and quality standards, while suppliers leverage their manufacturing processes and large-scale delivery capabilities; summarizing Li Auto's battery strategy with 'de-XX-ization' misrepresents the relationship between the two as a zero-sum game. 围绕自研电池是否会排斥供应商的行业争议，理想汽车 CEO 李想 9 月 28 日发表长文回应。他认为，整车企业负责定义产品体验、系统架构与质量标准，供应商发挥制造工艺和规模交付能力；用「去 XX 化」概括理想的电池战略，是把双方关系误写成零和博弈。

Examples cited by Li Xiang include the division of labor in the chip industry: Apple, Nvidia, and Qualcomm design chips, while TSMC is responsible for manufacturing; Tesla develops battery technology and also collaborates with companies like CATL for production. He used this to illustrate that car manufacturers delving into component R&D do not need to replace manufacturing partners. 李想举的例子包括芯片产业的分工：苹果、英伟达和高通设计芯片，台积电负责代工；特斯拉开发电池技术，也与宁德时代等企业合作生产。他以此说明，车企深入研发零部件，无需取代制造伙伴。

Speaking of Li Auto and CATL, Li Xiang recalled the high-power, large-capacity extended-range battery of Li ONE and the 5C super-charging battery of Li MEGA. He stated that these solutions were formed through Li Auto's deep product definition, joint R&D by both parties, and CATL's engineering and delivery support; he particularly thanked CATL for its early investment in the cooperation. 谈到理想与宁德时代，李想回顾了理想 ONE 的高功率大电量增程电池和理想 MEGA 的 5C 超充电池。他说，理想对产品做深度定义，双方联合研发，加上宁德时代的工程和交付支持，才形成这些方案；他特别感谢宁德时代在早期合作中的投入。

Regarding continuing deep in-house battery R&D, Li Xiang listed three reasons. First, there are sometimes no ready-made solutions for demands in range, low-temperature performance, charging speed, and safety, requiring Li Auto to participate in material-level R&D. Second, battery cells, PACKs, battery management, thermal management, and vehicle control should be designed together, and charging and energy management can still be improved via OTA after delivery. He cited the in-house developed high-voltage SiC electric drive system as an example, stating that the fault rate after system integration decreased compared to previously used solutions; this set of performance data is Li Auto's own statistics. 对于继续深度自研电池，李想列出三个理由。第一，续航、低温性能、补能速度和安全方面的需求有时没有现成方案，理想需要参与材料级研发。第二，电芯、PACK、电池管理、热管理和整车控制应一起设计，交付后仍可通过 OTA 改进充电与能量管理。他以自研高压 SiC 电驱系统为例，称系统集成后的故障率较此前使用的方案下降；这组效果数据是理想自身的统计。

Third, it is to integrate quality data across material, cell production, PACK manufacturing, and vehicle usage stages. Li Xiang stated that Li Auto's Lianshan system has been connected to vehicle and supplier production lines, allowing traceability of every cell and detection of production anomalies before delivery. His conclusion is that regardless of who undertakes production, Li Auto still bears the safety and after-sales responsibility to users, and therefore welcomes suppliers to participate more deeply in product development. 第三，是把材料、电芯生产、PACK 制造和车辆使用阶段的质量数据贯通。李想称，理想连山系统已接入整车及供应商产线，可追溯每颗电芯，并在交付前发现生产异常。他的结论是，无论生产由谁承担，面向用户的安全和售后责任仍由理想承担，因此欢迎供应商更深入参与产品开发。

item.title: 4499 元起，荣耀 Magic9 系列发布
item.guid: 4499-元起，荣耀-Magic9-系列发布
item.description:
Honor released the Magic9, Magic9 Pro Max, and Magic9 Super Edition on September 28, all of which are now on sale; the MagicPad 4 tablet and Watch 6 Pro were also launched at the same event. The phone series is distinguished by imaging, battery life, and different sizes: 荣耀 9 月 28 日发布 Magic9、Magic9 Pro Max 和 Magic9 超能版，均已开启销售；同场还推出 MagicPad 4 平板和手表 6 Pro。手机系列以影像、续航和不同尺寸区分：

    Magic9 Pro Max: The 12GB + 256GB version starts at 6499 yuan, featuring a 6.8-inch screen, the 6th generation Snapdragon 8 Super Ultimate Edition, two 200-megapixel rear cameras, and an 8800mAh battery, supporting 100W wired and 80W wireless charging. Honor also launched a compatible 500mm telephoto extender.

    Magic9: The 12GB + 256GB version starts at 4999 yuan, featuring a 6.37-inch screen, the 5th generation Snapdragon 8 Ultimate Edition, two 200-megapixel cameras, and an 8000mAh battery, compatible with a 200mm extender.

    Magic9 Ultra: The 12GB + 256GB version starts at 4499 yuan, featuring a 6.81-inch screen and the 5th Gen Snapdragon 8 Extreme Edition, with a built-in 11000mAh battery and active cooling fan, supporting 80W wired charging.

The Pro Max supports ARRI LogC3 video curve, 87 ARRI Looks, and directional shotgun microphones; the Magic9 adds a square-frame front camera and 3-second movie Live. Both models focus on photography, while the Ultra version emphasizes long battery life and heat dissipation. Pro Max 支持 ARRI LogC3 视频曲线、87 款阿莱 Look 和定向收音枪麦；Magic9 则加入方形画幅前置摄像头及 3 秒电影 Live。两款机型侧重拍摄，超能版侧重长续航和散热。

The MagicPad 4 uses a 12.1-inch 165Hz screen, 4th Gen Snapdragon 8s, and a 10100mAh battery, starting at 3299 yuan. The Watch 6 Pro features cardiac arrest monitoring and non-invasive blood pressure 2.0; related health functions must be used by joining research projects as per Honor's instructions. MagicPad 4 使用 12.1 英寸 165Hz 屏幕、第四代骁龙 8s 和 10100mAh 电池，售价 3299 元起。手表 6 Pro 主打心脏停搏监测与无感血压 2.0；相关健康功能须按荣耀说明加入研究项目使用。

🔗 Related Reading: The Million ARRI Disappearance Case | Honor Magic9 Pro Max First Review 🔗 相关阅读： 百万阿莱失踪案｜荣耀Magic9 Pro Max 首发评测

item.title: 智界 RX 正式上市，余承东：鸿蒙智行「最好开的车」来了
item.guid: 智界-RX-正式上市，余承东：鸿蒙智行「最好开的车」来了
item.description:
The Luxeed RX officially launched on September 28th. It features a BOOST button on the steering wheel, which, when pressed, activates exclusive accelerator pedal calibration and chassis tuning; another "A" button is reserved for future L3 autonomous driving functions and does not mean the function is already available. HarmonyOS Smart Travel also launched the refreshed Luxeed R7 and opened pre-orders for the Luxeed V8. The main product lines from the press conference are as follows: 智界 RX 9 月 28 日正式上市。它在方向盘上设置 BOOST 按键，按下后可调用专属加速踏板标定和底盘调校；另一枚「A」键为未来 L3 自动驾驶功能预留接口，并不代表该功能已经开放。鸿蒙智行同场还推出智界 R7 焕新款，并开启享界 V8 预订。发布会主要产品线如下：

    Luxeed RX: Positioned as a mid-to-large pure electric coupe SUV, with six configurations starting at 259,800 yuan, up to 389,800 yuan. It has a wheelbase of 3000mm, offers rear-wheel drive and four-wheel drive, adopts an 800V architecture, and is equipped with perception hardware including an 896-line lidar on the roof.

    Luxeed R7 Refreshed Model: Priced from 239,800 yuan, it adds configurations such as a 17.2-inch dual-linked screen and a smart constant-temperature refrigerator. The long-range version has a maximum CLTC pure electric range of 855km.

    Luxeed V8: This seven-seater MPV has a pre-sale price starting from 329,800 yuan, offering both pure electric and extended-range power options. The pure electric version uses a 120kWh battery with a maximum CLTC range of 830km; the second-row seats support rotating for easy entry.

The HarmonyOS Smart Travel official website has opened pre-order access for the Luxeed RX. The aforementioned ranges are test specifications announced by the manufacturer, and actual performance depends on configuration and usage conditions. 鸿蒙智行官网已开放智界 RX 预订入口。上述续航均为厂商公布的测试口径，实际表现取决于配置和使用条件。

🔗 Related Reading: Richard Yu: HarmonyOS Smart Travel's "Best Driving Car" is Here! Luxeed RX Launched, Starting from 259,800 Yuan 🔗 相关阅读： 余承东：鸿蒙智行「最好开的车」来了！智界 RX 上市，25.98 万元起

item.title: 华为开源盘古 2.0 训练代码，预训练、SFT 与强化学习仓库上线
item.guid: 华为开源盘古-2.0-训练代码，预训练、SFT-与强化学习仓库上线
item.description:
On September 28th, Huawei opened the training code for openPangu-2.0. Ascend Tribe added two new repositories on GitCode: `openPangu-2.0-Training` contains pre-training and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) code, and `openPangu-2.0-RL` contains reinforcement learning code, both marked with the Apache-2.0 license. 华为 9 月 28 日开放了 openPangu-2.0 的训练代码。Ascend Tribe 在 GitCode 上新增两个仓库：`openPangu-2.0-Training` 收录预训练和监督微调（SFT）代码，`openPangu-2.0-RL` 收录强化学习代码，均标示采用 Apache-2.0 许可证。

This release focuses on the training phase. Huawei previously released the model weights and basic inference code for openPangu-2.0-Flash and Pro in June and July, respectively, stating that more components would be gradually released later. The new repositories allow developers to view the relevant training implementations, but the repository pages currently only show brief descriptions, so it cannot be asserted that the entire model training process can be independently reproduced yet. 这次开放的是训练环节。华为此前分别在 6 月和 7 月发布了 openPangu-2.0-Flash 与 Pro 的模型权重和基础推理代码，并表示后续会逐步放出更多组件。新仓库让开发者能够查看相关训练实现，但仓库页面目前只展示简短说明，尚不能据此断言模型训练全过程已经可以独立复现。

item.title: BOOX 推出卡片大小的墨水屏 Picco，可磁吸在手机背面
item.guid: BOOX-推出卡片大小的墨水屏-Picco，可磁吸在手机背面
item.description:
On September 28th, BOOX released Picco, the first device in its newly established Tiles product line. Picco features a 3.97-inch black and white e-paper screen, weighs approximately 58 grams, and comes with a magnetic ring protective case that can be attached to the back of a phone for portability. The official store lists it for $109.99, and the page indicates it's available for pre-order. BOOX 9 月 28 日发布 Picco，这是其新设的 Tiles 产品线首款设备。Picco 配有 3.97 英寸黑白电子纸屏，机身重约 58 克；随附带磁环的保护壳，可吸附在手机背面携带。官方商城标价 109.99 美元，页面显示可预订。

This device features a screen resolution of 480 × 800 with a pixel density of 235 PPI, dual-color temperature front light, and supports touch control and physical page-turning buttons. It comes with a built-in 16GB storage card, expandable via microSD; books need to be transferred via the BOOX Tiles app or web, supporting formats like EPUB, MOBI, TXT. It also includes a Pomodoro timer, to-do list, and countdown functions. 这款设备的屏幕分辨率为 480 × 800、像素密度 235 PPI，配有双色温前光，支持触控和实体翻页键。机身内附 16GB 存储卡，可通过 microSD 扩展；书籍需经 BOOX Tiles 应用或网页传入，支持 EPUB、MOBI、TXT 等格式。它还内置番茄钟、待办和倒计时功能。

item.title: 英伟达推出 AI 智能体安全平台，用独立硬件监控越权行为
item.guid: 英伟达推出-AI-智能体安全平台，用独立硬件监控越权行为
item.description:
On September 28th, NVIDIA released the Open Agent Safety Platform, combining OpenShell software, which controls agent execution permissions, with the Sentry reference design, which monitors behavior on independent hardware. OpenShell is currently available for use, capable of recording agent operations and restricting their access scope; NVIDIA states that it can also be extended to third-party computing platforms like Arm and Intel. 英伟达 9 月 28 日发布 Open Agent Safety Platform，将控制智能体执行权限的 OpenShell 软件，与在独立硬件上监控行为的 Sentry 参考设计组合。OpenShell 目前已开放使用，可记录智能体操作并限制其访问范围；英伟达称，它也可扩展到 Arm、英特尔等第三方计算平台。

The Sentry design runs on a BlueField-4 DPU, checking behavior outside the agent's operating environment. If an agent attempts to cross software-defined boundaries, the system can isolate it. NVIDIA separated the two layers of control to ensure that security rules do not solely rely on the agent's own execution; the millisecond-level isolation capability listed in the release materials remains a manufacturer's description. Sentry 设计运行在 BlueField-4 DPU 上，在智能体运行环境之外检查行为。如果智能体试图越过软件设定的边界，系统可将其隔离。英伟达把两层控制分开，是为了让安全规则不完全依赖智能体自身执行；发布材料列出的毫秒级隔离能力仍是厂商描述。

NVIDIA states that Anthropic's Claude Managed Agents are integrating with OpenShell and BlueField, while Salesforce has integrated OpenShell into Slack for teams to view agent activity and handle additional permission requests. NVIDIA released open software and reference system designs; specific deployment depends on the user. 英伟达称，Anthropic 的 Claude Managed Agents 正与 OpenShell、BlueField 集成，Salesforce 则已将 OpenShell 接入 Slack，供团队查看智能体活动并处理额外权限请求。英伟达发布的是开放软件和参考系统设计，具体部署取决于使用方。

item.title: MiniMax 上线 M3.1-Flash-Preview，先在编程平台开放
item.guid: MiniMax-上线-M3.1-Flash-Preview，先在编程平台开放
item.description:
MiniMax has launched its text model M3.1-Flash-Preview on MiniMax Code, opening it for preview for daily development tasks. MiniMax's public statement lists uses such as fixing program errors and developing complete features, and simultaneously launched quota reset cards and a check-in points event from September 28th to October 7th. MiniMax 已将文本模型 M3.1-Flash-Preview 上线 MiniMax Code，面向日常开发任务开放预览。MiniMax 的公开说明举出修复程序错误、开发完整功能等用途，并同步推出额度重置卡和 9 月 28 日至 10 月 7 日的签到积分活动。

According to Yicai, the model supports multimodal input and a million-token context window, and can participate in problem localization, code implementation, and test verification. The official MiniMax application page currently also lists M3.1-Flash-Preview; the aforementioned capabilities and scope of availability are still subject to the actual product release. 第一财经报道称，该模型支持多模态输入与百万 token 上下文窗口，可参与问题定位、代码实现和测试验证。MiniMax 官方应用页面目前也已列出 M3.1-Flash-Preview；上述能力与可用范围仍以产品实际开放情况为准。

item.title: 大疆预告面向北京用户的无人机专属托管服务
item.guid: 大疆预告面向北京用户的无人机专属托管服务
item.description:
On September 28th, DJI Services posted a "Notice to Drone Enthusiasts: Beijing Drone Exclusive Custody Service Preview" on Xiaohongshu, announcing the launch of an exclusive custody service for consumer drone users in Beijing. This preview is set against the backdrop of the "Beijing Regulations on the Administration of Unmanned Aircraft Systems," and the DJI Help Center has also listed a corresponding explanation. 大疆服务 9 月 28 日在小红书发布「致飞友：北京无人机专属托管服务预告」，表示将面向北京消费级无人机用户推出专属托管服务。这则预告以《北京市无人驾驶航空器管理规定》为背景，大疆帮助中心也已列出同名说明。

The hosting location, fees, application conditions, and activation time are still subject to further details announced by DJI. The announcement itself does not mean that the service is already open for application. 托管地点、费用、申请条件与启用时间仍须以大疆进一步公布的细则为准。预告本身不等于服务已经开放办理。

item.title: 千问接入夸克网盘，可按授权读取和整理个人文件
item.guid: 千问接入夸克网盘，可按授权读取和整理个人文件
item.description:
Yesterday, the Qianwen App officially announced its integration with Quark Cloud Drive. Users can authorize Qianwen to query and organize cloud drive data, and generate study materials, work summaries, or photo collections based on files. 昨天，千问 App 官宣与夸克网盘打通，用户授权即可在千问中查询和整理网盘资料，并基于文件生成复习资料、工作总结或照片合集。

Quark Cloud Drive's official website has also listed "installation and use in agents like Qianwen" as a cloud drive capability, providing a one-sentence entry point for backing up, searching, and organizing files. 夸克网盘官网也已把「在千问等 Agent 中安装使用」列为网盘能力，并提供一句话备份、查找和整理文件的入口。

item.title: 荣耀推出磁吸墨水屏阅读器 S3，售价 359 元
item.guid: 荣耀推出磁吸墨水屏阅读器-S3，售价-359-元
item.description:
The HONOR Life Ink Screen Reader S3 was launched on September 28th, weighing approximately 61g and measuring about 5.6mm thick. It can be magnetically attached to the back of a phone and is priced at 359 yuan. It features a 3.68-inch ink screen with a pixel density of 259PPI, allowing users to turn pages by tapping the screen. 荣耀 HONOR Life 墨水屏阅读器 S3 9 月 28 日上架，机身重约 61g、厚约 5.6mm，可磁吸在手机背面使用，售价 359 元。它采用 3.68 英寸墨水屏，像素密度为 259PPI，点击屏幕即可翻页。

This device supports book transfer via Wi-Fi 6 and the HONOR Smart Space App, is compatible with formats such as epub, pdf, mobi, doc, docx, and txt, and allows storage expansion with a TF card. HONOR claims a continuous offline reading time of 30 hours. 这款设备支持通过 Wi-Fi 6 和荣耀智慧空间 App 传书，兼容 epub、pdf、mobi、doc、docx、txt 等格式，并可用 TF 卡扩展存储。荣耀标称其连续离线阅读时间为 30 小时。

item.title: 电车维修费引热议：1.7 倍是事故车维修统计
item.guid: 电车维修费引热议：1.7-倍是事故车维修统计
item.description:
On September 28th, topics related to "electric cars are affordable to buy but not to repair" trended on Weibo. Jiemian News mentioned that a case of a car owner whose battery pack casing buckle was damaged and was asked to replace the entire battery pack during repair circulated again; the quote and liability determination for this individual case still lack independent verification from the car manufacturer or insurance documents. 9 月 28 日，「电车买得起修不起」相关话题登上微博热搜。界面新闻提到，一则电池包外壳卡扣损坏、维修时被要求更换整个电池包的车主案例再次传播；这起个案的报价与责任认定尚缺车企或保险文件的独立核对。

The "1.7 times" cited in the hot discussion comes from J.D. Power's "2026 China New Energy Vehicle After-Sales Service Satisfaction Study" released on August 6th, comparing repair costs for new energy accident vehicles with those of fuel vehicles, not daily maintenance expenses, nor is it newly released data from September 28th. The report also pointed out that the service satisfaction of new energy vehicle owners after an accident is 67 points lower than that of the general accident repair population. 热议中引用的「1.7 倍」来自 J.D. Power 8 月 6 日发布的《2026 年中国新能源汽车售后服务满意度研究》，对比的是新能源事故车与燃油车的维修费，并非日常保养开销，也不是 9 月 28 日新公布的数据。报告还指出，新能源车主出险后的服务满意度比事故维修总体人群低 67 分。

A document released in June by the Ministry of Commerce and 9 other departments requires car manufacturers to enrich new energy vehicle repair and parts channels, guide complete vehicle and battery companies to open up repair technology authorizations, and encourage "repair over replacement". 商务部等 9 部门 6 月发布的文件要求车企丰富新能源汽车维修和配件渠道，引导整车与电池企业开放维修技术授权，鼓励「以修代换」。

item.title: 京东 101HOME 上海首店开业，推出 33 个实景「梦想之家」
item.guid: 京东-101HOME-上海首店开业，推出-33-个实景「梦想之家」
item.description:
JD 101HOME's first global store opened on September 28th in Shanghai's Jing'an Temple business district. JD previously announced that the store is approximately 12,000 square meters, spanning four floors, integrating furniture and home goods, smart technology, design services, dining, and art spaces in one location; consumers can view products in a simulated environment and place orders directly. 京东 101HOME 全球首店 9 月 28 日在上海静安寺商圈开业。京东此前公布，门店约 1.2 万平方米、共四层，将家具家居、智能科技、设计服务、餐饮与艺术空间放在同一场所；消费者可在场景中看商品并直接下单。

The store's 33 "Dream Homes" are arranged according to different family structures and lifestyles, with designers including Kelly Hoppen, Shuhei Aoyama, and Takashi Honma. JD states that the store brings together over 1,000 home and lifestyle brands and more than 15,000 products, with over 30 international brands entering the Chinese market for the first time. 门店的 33 个「梦想之家」按不同家庭结构和生活方式布置，参与设计的包括 Kelly Hoppen、青山周平和本间贵史。京东称，店内汇集逾 1000 个家居与生活方式品牌、超过 1.5 万件商品，其中 30 余个国际品牌首次进入中国市场。

item.title: 《野性的呼唤》将拍 AI 改编电影，《哈利·波特》制片人加入
item.guid: 《野性的呼唤》将拍-AI-改编电影，《哈利·波特》制片人加入
item.description:
According to Deadline, British producer David Barron, who was involved in the production of six Harry Potter films, will serve as the producer for the new film adaptation of Jack London's novel "The Call of the Wild." The new film is written and directed by Simon Rumley and plans to use generative AI for visuals in nmatic, combining CGI and traditional visual effects for complex scenes. 据 Deadline 报道，参与制作过六部《哈利·波特》电影的英国制片人 David Barron，将担任杰克·伦敦小说《野性的呼唤》新电影的制片人。新片由 Simon Rumley 编剧并执导，计划在 nmatic 使用生成式 AI 制作画面，复杂场景再结合 CGI 与传统视觉特效。

The production team hopes to tell the story from the subjective perspective of the sled dog Buck: how it was taken from its domestic life in California to the Klondike gold rush in the 1890s, gradually rediscovering its wild nature. The novel has been adapted multiple times, with the last widely known film version released in 2020, starring Harrison Ford. 制作团队希望从雪橇犬巴克的主观视角讲述故事：它从加州的家庭生活被带往 19 世纪 90 年代的克朗代克淘金地，逐渐找回野性。小说曾多次改编，上一部广为人知的电影版于 2020 年上映，由哈里森·福特出演。

item.title: 《戴帽子的猫》确认引进内地，档期待定
item.guid: 《戴帽子的猫》确认引进内地，档期待定
item.description:
News released by Warner Bros. Pictures indicates that the animated adaptation of Dr. Seuss's children's book "The Cat in the Hat" will be introduced to mainland Chinese cinemas, with the specific release date yet to be announced. The film is the first feature-length animated film produced by Warner Bros. Pictures Animation, scheduled for North American release on November 6th. 华纳兄弟电影发布的消息显示，苏斯博士童书改编动画《戴帽子的猫》将引进中国内地院线，具体上映日期尚未公布。影片是华纳兄弟影业动画制作的首部长篇动画电影，北美定于 11 月 6 日上映。

The film features Bill Hader as the voice of the Cat in the Hat, and is directed by Erica Rivinoja and Alessandro Carloni. In the story, the Cat in the Hat is tasked with helping siblings Gabby and Sebastian, who have moved to a strange town, get back on their feet; the official announcement also revealed voice actors such as Matt Berry, Quinta Brunson, and Bowen Yang. 电影由 Bill Hader 为戴帽子的猫配音，Erica Rivinoja 与 Alessandro Carloni 执导。故事中，戴帽子的猫受命帮助搬到陌生小镇的姐弟 Gabby 和 Sebastian 重新振作；官方还公布了 Matt Berry、Quinta Brunson、Bowen Yang 等配音演员。

item.title: 2026 年 MTV 音乐录影带大奖揭晓
item.guid: 2026-年-MTV-音乐录影带大奖揭晓
item.description:
The 2026 MTV Video Music Awards were held on the evening of September 27th, US local time. The complete list of winners announced by the organizers showed that Madonna was the most awarded artist of the night with seven awards, winning categories such as Artist of the Year and Best Dance; Taylor Swift won Video of the Year for "The Fate of Ophelia" and was honored with the inaugural Artist Director Award. 2026 年 MTV 音乐录影带大奖于美国当地时间 9 月 27 日晚举行。主办方公布的完整获奖名单显示，麦当娜以七奖成为当晚获奖最多的艺人，拿下年度艺人、最佳舞曲等类别；泰勒·斯威夫特凭《The Fate of Ophelia》获得年度音乐录影带，并获颁首届艺人导演荣誉。

In the list, LISA won Best Pop Video for "Dream," a collaboration with Kentaro Sakaguchi, and BTS's "Swim" won Song of the Year and Best K-pop Video. Swift also won Best Director for "Opalite." 名单中，LISA 凭与坂口健太郎合作的《Dream》获得最佳流行音乐录影带，BTS 的《Swim》获年度歌曲和最佳 K-pop 音乐录影带。斯威夫特还凭《Opalite》获得最佳导演奖。
